subject.title: [Bug] v2026.5.22 启动后 Gateway CPU 持续 100%+，导致请求延迟飙升 50-100 倍

question: Should default gateway startup stop running provider-auth discovery unless an internal caller explicitly opts into startup warming?
rationale: The narrow fix is available in an open maintainer PR, but it changes the auth-provider startup default for upgraded users and needs maintainer acceptance of the lazy/on-demand auth tradeoff.

options.title: Land Default-Off Startup Warm
options.body: Merge the current closing PR and accept lazy provider-auth preparation as the default startup contract.

options.title: Keep Eager Startup Warm
options.body: Reject the current PR and keep the existing startup behavior while pursuing a different mitigation.

options.title: Require More Upgrade Proof
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers see fresh-install and upgrade proof for setups that relied on eager prepared auth state.

recommendation.title: Land Default-Off Startup Warm
recommendation.body: Merge the current closing PR and accept lazy provider-auth preparation as the default startup contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He opened the current closing PR and has the clearest recent ownership of the default-off replay.
